children.name: Acarospora cervina
children.description: Acarospora cervina is a species of lichen in the Acarosporaceae family that may be referred to as reindeer lichen.

children.name: Acarospora citrina
children.description: Acarospora citrina is a lichen in the family, Acarosporaceae, first described as Urceolaria citrina by Thomas Taylor in 1847.

children.name: Acarospora contigua
children.description: Acarospora contigua is a species of saxicolous (rock-dwelling), crustose lichen in the family Acarosporaceae.

children.name: Acarospora fuscata
children.description: Acarospora fuscata ("brown cobblestone lichen") is a glossy pale or yellowish-brown areolate lichen with angular areolas that grows up to wide on non-calcareous rock in low and high elevations.

children.name: Acarospora obnubila
children.description: Acarospora obnubila ("cloudy cobblestone lichen") is a dull brown squamulose areolate crustose lichen that may grow up to 4 mm in diameter or with squamules scattered among other lichens.

children.name: Acarospora schleicheri
children.description: Acarospora schleicheri, the soil paint lichen, is a bleached to bright yellow areolate to squamulose lichen that commonly grows to on soil (terricolous) in arid habitats of southern California and Baja California, also in Europe and Africa.

children.name: Acarospora socialis
children.description: Acarospora socialis (bright cobblestone lichen) is a usually bright yellow areolate to squamulose crustose lichen in the family Acarosporaceae that grows up to 10 cm wide, mostly on rock in western North America.

children.name: Acarospora stapfiana
children.description: Acarospora stapfiana, the hoary cobblestone lichen, is a lichenicolous (lichen-dwelling) lichen species in the family Acarosporaceae.

children.name: Acarospora strigata
children.description: Acarospora strigata is an areolate to verruculous crustose lichen that grows on rock around the world, in full sun or shade, and in mesic to arid habitats.

children.name: Acarospora thamnina
children.description: Acarospora thamnina is a shiny, black tinged, variously brown squamulose crustose lichen.

children.name: Acarospora thelococcoides
children.description: Acarospora thelococcoides is a pruinose (dusty whitish) verruculose (warty) crustose lichen that grows in patches up to 10 cm across that grows on soil (terricolous), especially soils made from decomposed granite.

children.name: Acarospora veronensis
children.description: Acarospora veronensis is a medium brown to dark brown or black crustose lichen that grows up to wide.

children.name: Pleopsidium chlorophanum
children.description: Pleopsidium chlorophanum (gold cobblestone lichen) is a distinctively colored, bright lemon-yellow to chartreuse crustose lichen, which favors dry arctic or alpine sandstone cliffs and boulders.
